name: treg people search
provides: Find people, work emails and phone numbers across Apollo, Hunter, Lusha, Prospeo and more, paid per result; every paid lookup asks you first with its price cap
license: Apache-2.0 with an added no-hosted-resale term (superdesigndev/treg)

install.system: curl -fsSL https://treg.to/install.sh | sh (needs Python 3.12 or 3.13), then in your own terminal: treg login. New accounts get $1 of credit. Your own provider keys (treg secret add, or the treg dashboard) are used first and never billed by treg.

asks: every paid lookup, showing its price cap
note: Searching the catalog and reading prices is free. Every paid lookup asks you first with its price cap, and no standing answer covers it.
